The Respondents’ attempt to distinguish the same on the ground that it involved specific directions of the Rajasthan State Pollution Control Board is equally misplaced. The fundamental principle underlying the said decision is that expenditure incurred pursuant to directions of statutory environmental authorities is admissible, as it is in the nature of mandatory compliance. In the present case, the BSPCB Consent Order, issued under the statutory framework, imposes binding environmental conditions, and therefore stands on the same footing as directions issued by other Pollution Control Boards.
